identity.canonicalName: CRP62（Boon–Lewthwaite）｜原住民文化价值｜教师自评｜2015澳大利亚英文
identity.instrumentFamily: CRP62 / Boon & Lewthwaite / 2015 accepted manuscript / en-AU / teacher self-report

construct.constructDefinition: Indigenous Cultural Value；附录A保留题中的7项。原指导语为教师对课堂行为使用频率的自陈，不只测理念，也不是独立观察的教学质量。仅目录候选，不能施测。

population.populationNotes: 澳大利亚北昆士兰天主教学校小学及中学教师试点；原研究结合原住民学生和家庭经验。未有中国常模或经验证中文版本，不把本地原住民语境机械迁移。

administration.timeFrame: 原文未规定新回忆窗口；按自报课堂使用频率回答。
layoutConstraints: 保持附录A分区及原始V题号，不按1–62重新冒充原始编号。
原五档含百分比频率锚点；不能改为同意程度、能力感或理念。
作者讨论提出分区可独立使用；本项目无新的独立施测/跨文化等值证据，不将其另立门禁。

intendedUses.notes: 开发团队初步验证不能证明本项目独立分区版或中国情境等值；待权利范围审核。

localization.translationSource: Boon & Lewthwaite (2015) accepted manuscript, Appendix A and Section 4.3.
localization.notes: 原英文；中文目录和报告为项目编辑草稿，不是已验证中文翻译。

source.title: Development of an instrument to measure a facet of quality teaching: culturally responsive pedagogy
source.citation: Boon, H. J., & Lewthwaite, B. (2015). International Journal of Educational Research, 72, 38–58. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijer.2015.05.002. JCU accepted manuscript, Appendix A/B.

limitations: Original 2015 pilot uses Rasch Rating Scale Model; no executable Rasch scoring installed.
No scalar mean/sum, item difficulty as weight, 0–100 attainment percentage, norms, diagnostic cutoffs or teacher rankings.
Higher original person measures indicate greater self-reported frequency/endorsement of the source practices, not proof of actual teaching effectiveness.
Private categorical FORM preparation preserves raw responses; no reverse transform or numeric report.
V69 learning-preferences wording must not support diagnosing learning styles or matching instruction to fixed style types.
reportPlan.disclaimer: 元数据不可施测。完整题本已取得；许可标示冲突待澄清，原题不公开。内部FORM不是公共开发库或生产安装。教师本人发展性草稿沿既有接收者授权，不披露个人回答给无权者。

blockers: Repository record links CC BY 4.0 but actual accepted-PDF cover says CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; do not treat record alone as public adaptation/commercial grant.
Existing native scoring engine has no verified reproduction of the source Rasch person measures/step thresholds and missing/extreme policies; no new engine in this task.
Actual public developer/production installation, usage authorization and final production/admin dedup are not performed.
